answer: A new agent may only enter at the inlet by naming one established agent as its sponsor, and every sponsor's emission is diluted in proportion to how many newcomers it admits. A sybil farm therefore cannot skip the intake without forfeiting eligibility, so it must recruit real sponsors and consume their standing to admit clones. One copper thread of custody per newcomer means the farm's cost scales with the reputation it burns, while an honest agent keeps a single thread intact and gains from vouching.
